issues.quote: Herrgott, the regulator on the wall had stopped. And he had his repeater in his hand.
issues.fact: The fact sheet says nothing about the atelier regulator having stopped or about a repeater watch in the victim's hand. No time is attached to either.
issues.misreading: A solver could read the stopped regulator, or the repeater in hand, as a clock-based clue that fixes a time of stopping or of death. The sheet gives no such reading, so this points to a time the sheet does not support.
